event.quote: On November 22, 2026, the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.

watch.note: Headlines report that Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO after a period when the company faced a future without him, and that he is set to testify before Congress on Dec. 1 and Dec. 3.

digest.summary: US stocks were on pace for a strong Black Friday and the post-Thanksgiving session rose, with headlines citing a best Thanksgiving week in 18 years. The S&P 500 remains 6.5% below its one-year high after a volatile stretch tied to AI concerns. Recent gains were linked to Jensen Huang's reported return as Nvidia CEO, Anthropic's IPO trading, and a broader tech rebound, though one headline says investors still see persistent volatility.
digest.fed_note: The Fed headlines are routine releases (Oct. FOMC minutes, discount rate minutes, consumer credit thresholds) and do not state a policy direction; a Reuters gold story mentions lingering Fed-hike risks.
digest.sector_note: Headlines name no reason for the communication services (XLC) lead; the sources mention Anthropic, Tesla and SpaceX gains and a broader tech rebound, but do not explain XLC specifically.
